adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` on line 22 of groups_controller.rb with no upper bound validation. An attacker can pass an arbitrarily large limit value (e.g., limit=1000000) to retrieve all group members in a single request. This is a real security/DoS vulnerability - the code accepts any integer value for limit without capping it, allowing resource exhaustion attacks on large groups. The endpoint appears to be accessible without authentication for visible groups based on the controller code shown.
